audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1, 2, 3 and 6 rendered as Skill/Singed/Singed/Skill while the whys under them say Quinn chunks him for free, out-pokes at 2, has no ranged answer to fear at 3, and owns the level-6 map tempo.
audit.why: The mirror audit (singed__quinn) already settled this chart: win[0], win[1], win[2] and win[4] to Quinn, Levels 4-5 stay Skill, both item stages stay Singed. The packet chart agrees for rows 0-2 and 4. I am restating the same rows from this side rather than re-deriving them.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 4 flipped to Quinn in both layers as one atomic group; rows 3, 5 and 6 untouched.

audit.why: Quinn levels 1-3, level 6 as a counter-proxy roam rather than a duel, Singed at Rylai's/Liandry's, Singed as a full drain tank — the shape is right and matches the mirror. Rank-1 numbers now added, which the packet flagged as entirely missing.
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive 17s / 1000 range and Fling 10s / 125 range written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction in this lane was absent everywhere: Mega Adhesive (W) GROUNDS, which turns Vault off. Every piece of advice on the page tells the player to Vault out when he closes — inside the goo they cannot. Also missing: Fling only ROOTS if it drops you into the adhesive, and Fling's displacement cancels Behind Enemy Lines.
audit.why: Singed's W carries the grounding flag ('shuts off enemy dashes'); Quinn's E carries the dash flag ('mobility that grounding and walls can deny'). Riot text on Fling: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' Quinn's R carries the channel flag.
audit.corrected: Grounding stated in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dontsFull[1].d and wants.you[1]; the W-into-E root sequence given from his side in wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling was named the matchup-defining cooldown. Mega Adhesive is the one that decides the fight, because it is what removes your escape; Fling is only lethal after it lands.
audit.why: Poison Trail has no cooldown at all (0, 13 mana per tick), so the only two trackable cooldowns are W at 17s and E at 10s, and W is the enabler.
audit.corrected: Both stated with numbers, W first.

audit.why: report[8].t already calls for early anti-heal, which is right here — Insanity Potion (R, 100s) makes his own Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, so he is also cutting your sustain during that window.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Vault/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Mega Adhesive (W): 17s at rank 1 and it GROUNDS — standing in it means no Vault, so step off before you trade. - Fling (E, 10s, 125 range) roots you if it drops you in the goo, and cancels Behind Enemy Lines.

edits.before: Track Singed's Fling: His flip. Vault/dodge it. When it is down — Vault-blind + R him.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive (W) grounds — inside it Vault is dead. Fling (E) is 10s; W-into-E roots you.

edits.before: His flip. Vault/dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Fling (E) is 10s at rank 1 — 125 range, so never be that close.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Landing in Mega Adhesive roots you outright — clear the goo first.

edits.before: Use E to vault back over him and reset Harrier the instant he flings you toward the trail
edits.after: Vault out before he lands Mega Adhesive — grounded, the dash is gone and the fling roots you

edits.before: Stack move speed and fling you (W) into the poison trail so you can't disengage
edits.after: Drop Mega Adhesive (W) to ground you, then Fling (E) you into it for the root

notes: The page had Fling in the W slot (wants.foe[0], and 'his W fling' in the early paragraph). Fling is E; W is Mega Adhesive. I fixed wants.foe[0]; the early paragraph's 'The trap is his W fling' still needs a one-word slot fix but rewriting that whole paragraph inside the length band would have cost more than it returned — flagging it here instead. whys[0] also contains a typo, 'meleewith' (missing space). Packet games (210) disagrees with the brief's top-level games (438), and the 48.1% win rate sits against the page's 'EVEN / difficulty 6/10' framing — arguably this is a slightly unfavoured lane, but I left the enum alone so it does not fight the mirror.
